about: The team's task graph: what is left to do, what each task needs first, which files and devices it holds. No status here: done comes from 'evidence' (a commit on main) or from console events; ready, blocked and running are derived by fwcore (Lean). Task id = agent name = console card id. Edited by the lead; synced into the console with 'fw plan sync'. Revision 9 (2026-10-17): the experiment ends with a report by 2026-10-20 13:15 +0700 (see 'deadline'); milestone MX holds tasks cut in revision 9 and is never started; tasks marked '(only on GO at C1)' are cut if the WebKit Simulator lane is NO-GO at checkpoint C1. Revision 10 (2026-10-18): the evidence per part is a Lean theorem pair (same visual, no more work) under the engine models, for all t and all widths; CI counts falsify the models (F0-F5); the phone is an optional spot check with no dependents; milestone M5 holds the proof tasks.
